title: State v. R.K. & Anr. (?32 Crore Treasury SWIFT Exfiltration)
citation: Independent Contributor: Ret. DySP Ashok S. Patil (Anti-Corruption Bureau & Economic Offences Wing)
confidence_note: High - Confirmation bias trap: CFO Raman had ?8 Crore crypto debt and booked London flight, but physical HSM token was inserted into basement server switch while Raman was at airport.

ground_truth.culprit_summary: Senior Systems Architect K. Nambiar (Physical HSM Clone & Session Hijack)
ground_truth.rationale: Hardware Security Module (HSM) session logs confirm the physical cryptographic token was inserted directly into Switchport 8 in the basement server room at 02:14 AM. Biometric turnstile logs and airport CCTV confirm CFO Raman was at Mumbai Airport terminal departure hall at 02:14 AM with zero device connectivity. Nambiar's badge logged into the server room at 02:08 AM.

hypotheses.label: Chief Financial Officer Raman K. (Indebted Executive)
hypotheses.statement: CFO Raman authorized the ?32 Crore SWIFT wire to an offshore Panamanian account to liquidate crushing personal cryptocurrency debts before fleeing to London.

hypotheses.label: Senior Systems Architect K. Nambiar (Insider Network Intruder)
hypotheses.statement: Systems Architect Nambiar bypassed multi-factor controls by physically inserting an authorized cryptographic token into the core datacenter switchport while hijacking the CFO's authenticated web session.

hypotheses.label: External Ransomware / Cobalt Strike APT Syndicate
hypotheses.statement: An external advanced persistent threat group gained remote administrative control via unpatched perimeter VPN gateway.

exhibits.name: Datacenter Core Switchport 8 Telemetry & HSM Cryptographic Logs
exhibits.text: Cisco Catalyst 9500 switchport 8 telemetry proves the wire transaction was signed using a physically plugged-in YubiKey-HSM hardware token at 02:14:22 AM locally on VLAN 40 (Datacenter Operations). The physical token was located inside the secure basement server enclosure, requiring local physical contact.

exhibits.name: Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj International Airport CCTV & Immigration Timestamps
exhibits.text: Immigration checkpoint timestamps and CCTV verify CFO Raman was physically standing in the immigration queue at Terminal 2 from 01:50 AM to 02:35 AM with personal electronics sealed in checked luggage, establishing conclusive impossibility of physical presence in the basement server room.

exhibits.name: Basement Server Enclosure RFID Turnstile Log
exhibits.text: Badge access reader logs confirm Systems Architect Nambiar scanned his personal badge into the basement server enclosure at 02:08 AM and departed at 02:26 AM, perfectly encapsulating the 02:14 AM wire transfer.
